Game Overview

In Flip Bot, the core idea is straightforward: guide an agile robot through thrilling enemy-dodging challenges in Flip Bot. Tap the screen to execute swift flips while collecting vital batteries to sustain your energy. Quick thinking and precise timing are essential as enemies strike from all directions, testing your reflexes in this exhilarating arcade adventure.
